name: Fairmont Dallas
insider_take: The Fairmont Dallas stands as the city's premier luxury landmark, where Texas sophistication meets world-class hospitality in the heart of the bustling Arts District.
whats_special: This iconic tower features the city's largest hotel rooms and boasts the famous Pyramid Bar - a stunning rooftop venue with panoramic Dallas skyline views. The hotel's location puts you steps from the Dallas Museum of Art, AT&T Performing Arts Center, and the vibrant Deep Ellum entertainment district.
pro_tip: Book a north-facing room for spectacular views of downtown's glittering skyline, especially breathtaking during the golden hour before sunset.
dont_miss: The legendary Pyramid Bar for craft cocktails with a view, the hotel's proximity to Klyde Warren Park (just 3 blocks away), and easy access to the Dallas World Aquarium and historic West End district - all within walking distance or a quick ride on the free McKinney Avenue Trolley.
pros: Prime downtown Dallas location with skyline views
Professional business facilities and meeting spaces
Premium Fairmont Gold club level experience
cons: Urban setting with busy downtown traffic
